1Masthead co-branding lockup removedSCOPE: GLOBALMajorTG-GLOBAL-001
Content & Iconography  ·  Global — applies to every screen with this element
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT
The masthead right zone carries the SAMAVESH co-branding lockup — the Digital India logo + the SAMAVESH logo — before the user/avatar block.
BUILD — LIVE
Both logos are omitted portal-wide; only the user name/role/avatar remain on the right. (Present on the login hero, missing on every authenticated inner page.)
FIX
Restore the Digital India + SAMAVESH co-branding lockup in the masthead right zone per the design, on every screen.
2Masthead identity lockup reduced from 3 lines to 2SCOPE: GLOBALMinorTG-GLOBAL-002
Content & Iconography  ·  Global — applies to every screen with this element
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT
'Government of India / Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / Department of Social Justice & Empowerment' (Department line in bold navy).
BUILD — LIVE
Only 'Government of India / Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment' — the Department line is dropped and the bold weight moves up a line.
FIX
Render the full 3-line identity lockup with the Department line bold, per the design masthead.
3KPI cards lost their metric icon + trend lineSCOPE: GLOBALMajorTG-GLOBAL-003
Components & States  ·  Global — applies to every screen with this element
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT
Each dashboard KPI card shows a leading metric icon and a delta/trend line ('▲ +14.5% vs last month' or a contextual subtitle).
BUILD — LIVE
KPI cards render only a label + number — the icon and trend/subtext are dropped, losing the at-a-glance comparison hierarchy.
FIX
Restore the KPI card icon and trend/delta subtitle per the design KPI component. Applies to all role dashboards.
4Pagination active-page state differsSCOPE: GLOBALMinorTG-GLOBAL-004
Components & States  ·  Global — applies to every screen with this element
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT
Active page = outlined (white fill, navy border, navy numeral).
BUILD — LIVE
Active page = a navy-filled chip with a white numeral.
FIX
Match the pagination active-page control to the design's outlined style. Applies to every paginated table.
5Data-table header fill inconsistent across the buildSCOPE: GLOBALMinorTG-GLOBAL-005
Color & Token  ·  Global — applies to every screen with this element
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT
Table headers use a light neutral-gray fill (≈#f9fafb, Stroke/50).
BUILD — LIVE
Dashboard queue tables use a near-neutral header, but the User/Role/Tenant management tables use a light blue header tint (≈#dbeafe).
FIX
Standardise all data-table headers to the neutral-gray header token; drop the blue tint on the management tables.

1Role-tab switcher removedMajorTG-CIT-SIGNIN-001

DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT

BUILD — LIVE

FIX
Restore the Citizen / Admin / Garima Greh role-tab switcher at the top of the login card, per the design frame.
2Extra Mobile Number fieldMajorTG-CIT-SIGNIN-002
Components & States
DESIGN — FIGMA INTENT
The design offers a single Email field under 'or sign in with credentials', then a Send OTP button.
BUILD — LIVE
The build inserts a second 'Mobile Number' field (with its own 'or' divider) below the Email Id field — absent from the design.
FIX
Align to the design's single-field pattern, or update the design frame if the Mobile Number entry is a deliberate addition.

Match the design's sentence-case heading: 'Log in to your account'.
